title: Let me think about it, from a lead that went cold
scenario: Hannah got a loan estimate for a cash-out refinance to consolidate debt, then stopped responding. The rep reaches her, uncovers the real hesitation behind "let me think about it," and stays compliant.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi Hannah, it's Omar from Copperleaf Home Loans. I sent over your loan estimate a couple weeks ago and wanted to make sure you got it.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh, hi. Yeah, I got it. I just haven't had a chance to really look at it.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's fine. Did anything jump out at you when you skimmed it?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Not really. I think I just need to think about it some more.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Of course, it's a big decision. Usually when people want to think about it, there's one specific part that's bugging them. Is it the cost, the timing, or something else?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I guess, um, it's that I'd be taking on a bigger mortgage. That feels scary even if it pays off the cards.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's a really honest answer, and a totally normal feeling. Can I ask how many cards we're talking about?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Okay. One thing I'd suggest is we look at the total you're paying each month across all of those, versus after. Not a promise of savings, just an honest side by side.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, that would help. I've never actually added it all up.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Most people haven't. Do you want to do that together on a quick call, or would you rather I just put it in a one-page sheet?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Maybe a call. I'll have questions.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Sounds good. Would Wednesday at noon or Thursday after five be better?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Thursday after five. I'm usually walking the dog around then, but I can do it after.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: A very old beagle named Pickles.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Ha, great name. Okay, Thursday at five-thirty. Grab your card statements if you can.
